info.title: Ferrix API (Ajira Copilot)
info.summary: Voice-first worker intake, explainable matching, and the human trust pipeline — as a public API.
info.description: Ferrix (Ajira Copilot) public API. Auth contract: mutating routes require 'Authorization: Bearer $FERRIX_API_TOKEN' (or 'x-api-key') when that env var is set; unset = open judge demo. EVERY response carries the 'x-ferrix-auth' header (open-demo | enforced). Hand-maintained; kept in lockstep with docs/API.md and the QA suites.

get.description: Candidates assessed, placements/resolutions, median time to first human contact, and count of human-verified coordinator actions. No auth.

post.summary: Send an intake message / start a conversation (guarded mutation)
post.description:
Single endpoint for the whole intake conversation.

- With `persona` and no `candidateId`: mints a candidate, seeds the persona baseline and the AI intro message.
- With `candidateId` + `message`: appends the user message, asks the LLM for the next ONE intake question, appends the assistant reply, and returns the full transcript.
- With `candidateId` and no `message`: returns the transcript without advancing (`mode: "idle"`).

Notes: `lang` is accepted as a tolerant alias of `language`. If the LLM is unavailable the route still answers 200 with a scripted reply and `mode: "fallback"` (the demo can't die).

There is no `GET /api/chat` — transcripts arrive in this response or via the case payload.

Rate limit: 60 requests/min per IP (429 with `Retry-After`).

200.description: Transcript + next stage. `mode` is `live` (LLM reply), `fallback` (scripted reply) or `idle` (no message sent).

400.description: Malformed JSON, message over 2000 chars / empty after trim, or neither a message nor a persona to create.

post.summary: Structure the profile, score matches, open/refresh the case (guarded mutation)
post.description:
Runs the transcript of `candidateId` through the LLM to produce a Zod-shaped `StructuredProfile` (scripted persona fallback if the LLM fails), persists it, then scores active opportunities with the deterministic explainable matcher.

Every persisted `Match` row is stamped with `matcherVersion`, and the response echoes it (top level + per match). `DELETE`-and-recreate semantics: prior matches for the candidate are replaced. Reuses the candidate's open (non-resolved) case instead of minting a duplicate; creates a case (`AJR-…` ref) with `structured` events otherwise.

`mode` is `live` when the LLM produced the profile, `fallback` when the persona baseline was used.

Rate limit: 10 requests/min per IP (LLM-heavy; 429 with `Retry-After`).

200.description: Structured profile, ranked explainable matches (max 4), and the target case.

400.description: Malformed JSON or body failing the Zod contract (`candidateId` required).

get.summary: List coordinator cases with candidate, matches and events (open read)
get.description:
All cases ordered by status then newest-first, serialized through the shared `serializeCase` shape (identical to the single-case GET). JSON-string columns are parsed defensively — a corrupt row cannot 500 the list.

There is no `POST /api/collect`-style create here: cases are minted by `/api/analyze` (AI handoff), not by clients.
Same case shape as the list endpoint, including the candidate's ranked matches (each with human-readable `reasons`) and the append-only case events (actor: AI / Coordinator / System).

patch.description:
Human coordinator action. Enforced state machine (`Invalid transition: …` 400 otherwise):

| action | required current status | new status |
|---|---|---|
| `accept` | `new` | `accepted` (auto-assigns mentor, opens verification checklist) |
| `contact` | `accepted` | `contacted` |
| `place` | `contacted` | `placed` — requires `opportunityId`; writes a verified PLACEMENT track-record entry |
| `resolve` | `placed` | `resolved` |
| `note` | any | unchanged — requires `note` |

`place` on an already-`placed` case and `resolve` on an already-`resolved` case answer `409`. All writes (case status, candidate status, events, track-record entry) run in one transaction — no partial state.

400.description: Malformed JSON, unknown action, invalid transition for the current status, `note` missing for `note`, or `opportunityId` missing for `place`.

404.description: Case not found, or the `opportunityId` given for `place` does not exist.

409.description: Case already placed (`place`) or already resolved (`resolve`).

get.description: Verified passport entries (PLACEMENT / TRAINING / REVIEW) for `candidateId`, newest first, plus a summary (counts, average review rating, verified count, last verified date). Unknown candidate → 404, missing query param → 400.

post.summary: Add a verified passport entry (guarded mutation)
post.description: A human coordinator adds a verified entry (placement, completed training, or employer review) to the worker's passport. Entries are stored `verified: true` with `verifiedBy` (defaults to `"Coordinator (Ujuzi Hub)"`); `rating` is only stored for REVIEW entries. `occurredAt` accepts any parseable datetime string and defaults to now.

400.description: Malformed JSON or body failing the Zod contract (kind enum, title 1–200 chars, rating 1–5, valid `occurredAt`).

post.summary: Generate a WhatsApp catalog or plain-text CV (guarded mutation)
post.description:
Uses the candidate's persisted structured profile (so `/api/analyze` must have run first, else `400 "Profile the candidate first"`) to generate either a `catalog` (WhatsApp-ready stock list) or a `cv` (plain-text CV). Falls back to a deterministic template (mode `fallback`) when the LLM is unavailable.

There is no `GET /api/asset` — assets are generated on demand, not stored.

Rate limit: 20 requests/min per IP (429 with `Retry-After`).

400.description: Malformed JSON, bad `kind`, or the candidate has no structured profile yet.

get.summary: Check whether a candidate has a recorded voice bio (open read)
get.description: Returns `hasVoiceBio` and, when present, the stored base64 data-URL audio (the worker's self-recorded passport intro, max 25s / 1.5MB).

post.summary: Persist a candidate's self-recorded voice bio (guarded mutation)
post.description: Body: `{ candidateId, audio }` where `audio` is a base64 `data:audio/` URL (MediaRecorder webm/mp4/ogg). Body must be <= 1.5MB. The bio plays back on the work passport so clients can hear the worker before hiring. Consent-native: the worker records it themselves.

400.description: Malformed JSON or audio not a data:audio/ URL.

get.description: Meta Cloud API subscription handshake. Requires `hub.mode=subscribe`, `hub.verify_token` matching `WHATSAPP_VERIFY_TOKEN`, returns `hub.challenge` verbatim. Unset/wrong token -> 403 bilingual JSON. See docs/CHANNELS.md.

403.description: Verification failed or token not configured.

post.description: Receives Meta Cloud API events. Signature: `X-Hub-Signature-256` HMAC-SHA256 verified when `WHATSAPP_APP_SECRET` is set (mismatch -> 401); unset secret = documented open-demo mode (unsigned accepted). Text messages are persisted, profiled via the same intake engine as /api/chat, and answered (reply echoed in the JSON response; outbound send is a logged no-op until `WHATSAPP_ACCESS_TOKEN`/`WHATSAPP_PHONE_NUMBER_ID` are set). Voice notes are acknowledged with an STT-roadmap notice. ALWAYS answers 200 to Meta (never 500); per-sender throttle and externalId idempotency applied.

bearerAuth.description: FERRIX_API_TOKEN. Required on mutating endpoints only when the deployment sets FERRIX_API_TOKEN (auth mode `enforced`; watch the `x-ferrix-auth` response header). `x-api-key: <token>` is accepted as an equivalent alternative header. In open demo mode (`x-ferrix-auth: open-demo`) no token is needed.

XFerrixAuth.description: Auth mode of the deployment for this request: `open-demo` (mutations open) or `enforced` (mutations require the token). Contract: every response carries it — today it is verifiably present on success responses and 401 auth rejections; the shared 400/404/429 helpers are being wired to stamp it as well.

Unauthorized.description: Auth is enforced and the caller did not present the coordinator token (`Authorization: Bearer <token>` or `x-api-key`).

error.description: Short machine-readable error (first Zod issue message, or a stable label).

message.description: Human-readable detail. Present on 401 auth failures.

placements.description: Cases in status placed or resolved.

medianFirstContact.description: Median hours from case creation to first Coordinator event, formatted (e.g. "3.5 hrs", "—" when none).

candidateId.description: Existing candidate. Omit + send persona to mint one.

message.description: Trimmed by the server; empty-after-trim and >2000 chars are rejected.

persona.description: Persona key to mint a candidate from: mama_fua | mama_mboga | boda | cashier | fundi.

stage.description: Intake stage the next reply addresses.

tags.description: Lowercase slug tags used by the matcher (e.g. "customer-service").

aiSummary.description: AI narration; always recommends human verification before placement.

matcherVersion.description: Scorer version that produced this score.
Version of the matcher that produced these scores; also stamped on each persisted Match row.

mode.description: How the profile was produced (LLM vs persona baseline).

CaseMatch.description: Persisted match as read back from the database. Carries no matcherVersion today (see docs/API.md — serializer is owned by the cases engineer).

action.description: structured | assigned | accepted | contacted | placed | resolved | note | mentor_requested

note.description: Required for action=note; otherwise becomes the contacted/resolved event detail.

reviews.description: REVIEW entries that carry a rating.

avgRating.description: Mean review rating, 1 decimal; null when no rated reviews.
